# @solana-programs/goki-token-signer

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@solana-programs/goki-token-signer.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@solana-programs/goki-token-signer)

TypeScript client for the Goki Token Signer program, which lets an NFT holder sign for a PDA derived from the NFT's mint

<!-- Generated by `bun run codegen` from programs/goki-token-signer/. Edit programs/goki-token-signer/README.md instead. -->

## Installation

```bash
bun add @solana-programs/goki-token-signer @solana/kit
```

## About Goki Token Signer

Token Signer lets the holder of an NFT sign instructions on behalf of a PDA derived from that NFT's mint (`findNftSignerPda({ mint })`, seeds `"GokiTokenSigner"`, mint), via `invokeSignedInstruction`.

## Program

- Name: `tokenSigner`
- Address: `NFTUJzSHuUCsMMqMRJpB7PmbsaU7Wm51acdPk2FXMLn`
- Reference: [docs/token-signer.md](./docs/token-signer.md)
